title: FTTH ENGINEER
company: Cityline IT SERVICES Auth partner Airtel Broadband
description:
**Company Description**
Cityline IT Services is an authorized partner of Airtel Broadband, supporting fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) connectivity and related network services. The company focuses on delivering reliable high-speed broadband solutions to residential and commercial customers. Cityline IT Services works closely with Airtel to implement and maintain FTTH infrastructure that meets strict quality and performance standards. Team members collaborate with field and technical staff to ensure efficient installations, timely service delivery, and strong customer satisfaction. The organization values safety, professionalism, and continuous improvement in all technical and customer-facing operations.
  
**Role Description**
The FTTH Engineer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Palwal. The engineer is responsible for planning, installing, configuring, and maintaining FTTH network infrastructure, including fiber routing, splicing, testing, and ONT/OLT configurations. Daily tasks include conducting site surveys, preparing installation plans, coordinating with field technicians, and ensuring that all work complies with technical standards and safety procedures. The role involves troubleshooting network issues, performing regular performance checks, and documenting all activities, including as-built drawings and reports. The FTTH Engineer also interacts with customers and internal teams to resolve service-related concerns, support new activations, and contribute to continuous improvement of network reliability and quality.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of FTTH technologies, fiber optics, and broadband network architecture (OLT, ONT, splitters, fiber distribution).
* Hands-on experience with fiber installation, splicing, testing tools (OTDR, power meter), and basic network configuration.
* Understanding of network protocols and fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching) and basic troubleshooting methods.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, network diagrams, and installation plans, with accurate documentation skills.
* Good communication and customer service skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with field teams and clients.
* Commitment to safety procedures, quality standards, and on-site best practices in field engineering work.
* Relevant technical diploma or degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related field; industry certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in FTTH or broadband field operations is preferred; willingness to travel locally as required.

title: Technical Assistance Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Network TAC2 Engineer to provide advanced technical support for enterprise networking infrastructure. The role involves troubleshooting complex network issues, configuring and hardening Cisco devices, and ensuring high availability across the network environment, working in a 24×7 shift-based support model.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 2 technical support for network-related incidents escalated from TAC1, ensuring timely diagnosis and resolution.
* Configure,
  **troubleshoot**
  , and maintain Cisco routers and switches in production environments.
* Design and implement high-availability solutions using HSRP and other failover mechanisms to minimize downtime.
* Configure and manage AAA (Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting) for secure network access control.
* Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize BGP routing for WAN/ISP connectivity and multi-site environments.
* Plan and execute Cisco IOS upgrades, including compatibility checks, rollback planning, and change management coordination.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring or critical network incidents and provide permanent fixes.
* Maintain accurate documentation of network configurations, topology diagrams, and troubleshooting runbooks.
* Collaborate with TAC1, NOC, and engineering teams to resolve escalations and improve network stability.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs for incident response and resolution.
* Work in a 24×7 rotational shift environment, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays as per roster.

**Key Skills Required**

**Technical Skills**

**Routing Protocol**

Static, Dynamic (OSPF, BGP)

**Redundancy Protocol**

HSRP, VRRP, GLBP

**Router configuration.**

Hand-on experience on Cisco must. Fortinet, Huawei would be add-on.

**IOS Upgradation**

Planning and executing Cisco IOS upgrades with minimal downtime

**Others**

VLAN, AAA, IPSEC, Netflow, SNMP, TCP/IP, Subnetting

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Electronics, or a related field. (B. Tech Any Specialization BCA MCA, BSc IT.
* Minimum 2-4 years of experience in network support/TAC roles, preferably in an ISP, telecom, or large enterprise environment.
* **Cisco certifications preferred:**
  CCNP (Routing & Switching / Enterprise), CCNA as minimum.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, IPSEC, Failover and general networking fundamentals.
* Familiarity with network monitoring tools (Everest/Zabbix/SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, etc.).
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

**Work Details**

* Shift: 24×7 Rotational (Rotational offs)
* Location: Manesar
* Diversity Considered

Notice Period Minimum 30 Days Immediate joinee
